name: PostHog
one_liner: Open-source product analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B testing, and surveys in one stack.
voice: Direct, developer-first, a little irreverent. No jargon, no buzzwords. Sentences sound like something an engineer would actually say. Confident without bragging.

typography.notes: PostHog uses Matter; we fall back to Helvetica Neue which is available on macOS. Heavy weights for display, medium/regular for body. Tight line-height on headlines (1.05-1.1), relaxed on body (1.35-1.45).

background_aesthetic.description: Minimal quiet canvas. Almost a plain wash. Soft radial gradient in the ICP accent color anchored at one corner or edge, bleeding gently toward the center but never reaching it. The middle 60% of the frame is nearly uniform so the headline sits cleanly. Think: premium paper, minimalist gallery wall, not a scene.
forbidden: objects of any kind (no laptops, phones, hands, people, furniture, plants, UI mockups)
geometric patterns, grids, dots, or lines
gradients that cross the center band (y: 280 to 850)
